bio: The older Camardelli, and the patient one. Came up through the Argentine road races — Buenos Aires to Mendoza and back on surfaces that would have finished a European car — and arrived in Europe already knowing how to nurse a machine to the flag. Mercedes-Benz signed him for the W154 on the strength of a Tripoli drive in which he passed nobody and finished second. Reads a race the way his brother refuses to.
